evidence_quotes.O: I got one of these to play around with when it was first available. It's an interesting little device.
evidence_quotes.C: it took me more than 4 hours to get everything working (and another 1.5 hours to write this review).
evidence_quotes.E: and you can let any number of friends view the camera - they don't need to own a camera.
evidence_quotes.A: If you take the few minutes to read this review, however, you will have the instructions you need to set it up in under 15 minutes.
evidence_quotes.N: I was disappointed at the lack of longevity, but thought I'd give Sansa another try.
